items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: HP-style value bar on Base UI Meter: visible label and value/max text, announced as a meter with aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext. Static, no animation. variant="dots" draws whole dot columns; low = every 2nd column, critical = every 3rd in the alert colour.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. No original assets are used. v4: variant="dots" (opt-in; the hatched bar stays the default).
